title: Grateful Dead Live at McDonough Arena, Georgetown U. on 1970-10-23
lineage: AUD > Sony TC-124 (MCass) > DAT > DAT > CDR > SHN

ai_review.summary: Above‑average 1970 audience tape with solid electric set – good balance, audible bass and high‑energy performances highlighted by Good Lovin', Casey Jones and Sugar Magnolia.
ai_review.review: The recording is a well‑preserved audience capture from the fall‑70 college tour; listeners repeatedly note that the mix is surprisingly clear for an aud source with decent bass presence and balanced levels, especially after recent remastering. Musically the show is praised for its high energy, classic renditions of Good Lovin', Casey Jones, Hard to Handle and a lively Sugar Magnolia, though a few reviewers call out occasional wobble or crackle in the tape.

ai_rating.rationale: Average of 23 reviews (~3.6 stars) with most emphasizing good performance and decent audio; weighting favors the strong musical content despite some complaints about tape quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear for an audience tape – bass audible, balanced mix, occasional wobble/crackle and brief drop‑outs; remastered version smooths breaks and improves balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy electric set (often paired with NRPS), crowd fully engaged, strong transitions and a memorable encore; the show is remembered as a classic fall‑70 performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia 'kicks butt' with solid guitar tone and energetic playing throughout.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill's drumming highlighted for tight polyrhythms on Casey Jones; overall rhythm section described as being 'on'.
